Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 go_block('units_information');
 if :s_unit_count = 0 then
 show_error('0085');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 execute_query;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 end if;
exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select batch_id
 into :batch_id
 from batch_inputs
 where batch_id = :batch_id
 and substr(batch_id,8,2) = 'CB'
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 show_error('1130');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select count(*)
 into :s_unit_count
 from units
 where batch_id = :batch_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

-- below code by Jairam Kulkarni to convert GMT to local time
-- on 7-Mar-2011

declare
 --v_local_time timestamp;
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_time1 date;
 v_local_time2 date;
 
begin
 
-- if is_timezone_enabled then
 if :units_information.bleed_start_time is not null then
 if :global.time_zone_enabled = 'Y' then 
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :units_information.bleed_start_time, v_local_time);
 
 :units_information.bleed_start_time := v_local_time;
 else

 end if;
 end if;
 
 if :units_information.bleed_end_time is not null then

 :units_information.bleed_end_time := v_local_time1;
 else

 end if;
 
 if :units_information.qc_checkin_date is not null then

 else

 end if;

end;
